title: Rate limit an endpoint with Redis
summary: A fixed-window limiter in Express middleware, counted in Redis: let a client through to its allowance, answer 429 after that, and make sure the window actually turns over.

checkpoints.title: A client gets through until it hits the limit
checkpoints.hint: One INCR per request gives you the count. The headers go on every response, not just the ones you turn away, and remaining is limit minus what has been used.

checkpoints.title: Past the limit it answers 429
checkpoints.hint: Answer and return: calling next() as well runs the handler you were guarding. Retry-After is whole seconds and never zero.

checkpoints.title: The window actually turns over
checkpoints.hint: INCR on a missing key creates it with no deadline at all, so something has to call EXPIRE. Calling it on every request is the trap: the deadline keeps moving and a busy client is locked out for good.

checkpoints.title: Each client has its own allowance
checkpoints.hint: The counter key has to carry who the request came from. Fall back to something rather than throwing when there is no API key.
